brief: THE BET - take the swing, 150-300 lines is expected and welcome. The band above the town's roofline is about a fifth of a wide frame (sky runs rows 58-416 of a ~1660-row canvas at the cross-street column, seed 42, day 3, 10.4h, shots/m150a-wide.png) and it is the only part of the picture that is not a place. drawBackdrop() gives that whole distance ONE hazed hill silhouette and ONE band of flat blocks walked along a single base at hz + 3.2*cellH, in one flat colour, plus 120 stars and 80 hashed lit dots - all cached on backKey = WxH:lightBucket. The town does not recede into anything; it stops at row 0 against a cut-out. Give the distance DEPTH: three or four receding bands, each on its own base with its own house rhythm and its own mix toward HAZE, carrying chimneys, one or two further towers, and windows that light after dark the way the near town's do. A visitor should read a town that continues past the frame rather than one that ends at it. This is the spatial climb this run can still make: the grid is full and cannot grow, so the world grows in DEPTH beyond it - the field edge east of GW and #145's water mirror are both precedents in the source.
successLooksLike: At Wide on a fair morning the town has three or more distinguishable distances behind its roofline, each paler and hazier than the one in front of it; after dark the nearer far bands carry lit windows and the furthest does not. A same-code control run shows the backdrop band's mass moved well clear of the control floor while everything below the horizon is byte-identical.
avoid: Do not touch anything below the horizon - the near town is settled, and the diff must be confined to the backdrop layer. Do not put the new depth into the cache KEY: backKey is WxH:lightBucket, so anything that must move with the season, the wind or the drift is not a cached band and belongs where drawClouds already is. Grade it on sd/mean against a SAME-CODE control, never on absolute luma under a compositing wash, and crop the filmstrip to the band - a whole-frame rate is blind under 2% of the canvas. A surface can be flat BY CONSTRUCTION: read what the existing silhouette's own hash is scaled by before you decide it needs a new system. Do NOT expect the structural census scalars to move - this is depth beyond the grid and the census cannot see it. Say so in the entry.
